import asyncio

async def run(n_tasks, limit):
    running = 0
    peak = 0
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(limit)

    async def worker():
        nonlocal running, peak
        async with sem:
            running += 1
            peak = max(peak, running)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
            running -= 1

    await asyncio.gather(*(worker() for _ in range(n_tasks)))
    return peak

print(asyncio.run(run(10, 3)))
print(asyncio.run(run(10, 1)))
